page_title: CAG 2-2 PIS | Cagliari v Pisa 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Henrik Meister (Pisa) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
90+3' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) for his blatant foul.

90+3' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) pounces on a loose pass, cuts inside an opponent and unleashes a piledriver towards goal. The keeper scrambles to save the effort, but it curls just wide of the left post.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 2 Stefano Moreo (Pisa) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
88' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
85' Lorran (Pisa) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolo Cavuoti (Cagliari) will replace Gianluca Gaetano.
82' Substitution. Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) in, Semih Kilicsoy out.
82' Here is a change. Matteo Tramoni is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).
81' The substitution has been made. Lorran (Pisa) has replaced Idrissa Toure.
79' A yellow-coloured card is received by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari).
74' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Gabriele Piccinini and he is replaced by Stefano Moreo (Pisa).
74' The game has come to an end for Giovanni Bonfanti. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Arturo Calabresi (Pisa).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isak Vural (Pisa) is coming onto the pitch as Malthe Hojholt cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' The resulting corner from Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
71' 2 - 1 An excellent first touch by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
67' The game is interrupted. Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
63' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) replaces Michael Folorunsho.
60' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
59' 1 - 1 Goal! Gabriele Zappa picks out Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the left side of the goal with a header from close range. 1:1.
55' Substitution. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Michel Adopo walks off.
54' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is booked.
52' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Francesco Fourneau pulls out a yellow card.
49' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Pisacane decided to make a change. Adam Obert is replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 0 - 1 Goal! Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Elia Caprile.
45' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' The players claim that Michel Adopo (Cagliari) handled the ball and it seems they are right. PENALTY to Pisa! Let's see who will take responsibility.
42' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
40' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) commits a foul and Francesco Fourneau immediately signals a free kick.
39' Now Pisa have a corner.
39' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) tries to find Gianluca Gaetano, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
35' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Adrian Semper.
34' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Adrian Semper.
33' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) latches onto a pass under pressure from an opponent, but still gets his shot away. It’s a fine effort, but goes just over the bar.
33' Great teamplay by Cagliari as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' Flag up against Marco Palestra (Cagliari). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
29' Adam Obert (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but Adrian Semper punches the ball away.
27' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post.
27' The ball goes behind for a corner. Pisa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) latched on to a good cross from the corner kick and attempts to finish, but he misses to the right of the target.
23' Pisa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
18' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Elia Caprile easily makes the save.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Samuele Angori (Pisa) but poses no threat.
15' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
12' The opposition can't get near Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
11' The ball is cleared after Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
6' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
3' Pisa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

2' Elia Caprile pulls off a stunning save to block the free kick from Matteo Tramoni (Pisa). The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal. The linesman points to the corner flag, Pisa are going to take it.
1' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Pisa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Francesco Fourneau will referee today's match.
